meta.name: ai-agents-architect
meta.description: Expert in designing and building autonomous AI agents. Masters tool use, memory systems, planning strategies, and multi-agent orchestration. Use when "build agent, AI agent, autonomous agent, tool use, function calling, multi-agent, agent memory, agent planning, langchain agent, crewai, autogen, claude agent sdk, ai-agents, langchain, autogen, crewai, tool-use, function-calling, autonomous, llm, orchestration" mentioned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并构建自主AI智能体系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要设计自主AI智能体并编排多智能体协作。
copy.tagline_en: Design and build autonomous AI agent systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design autonomous AI agents and orchestrate multi-agent collaboration.

howto.what: Claude 成为 AI Agent 系统架构师，帮你设计自主 Agent：搭建工具调用、记忆系统、规划策略和多智能体编排，并引用内部参考文件给出最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你提到“构建agent”、“AI agent”、“多智能体”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个能调用搜索和数据库的工具型Agent
say.note: Claude会给出架构建议和实现步骤

say.text: 如何让多个Agent协作完成一个复杂任务？
say.note: Claude会讲解多智能体编排模式

say.text: 我的Agent经常出错，怎么设计容错机制？
say.note: Claude会引用内部参考给出故障处理方案

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an AI Agent Systems Architect, helping you design autonomous agents: tool use, memory systems, planning strategies, multi-agent orchestration, with reference files for best practices.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "build agent", "AI agent", "multi-agent", etc.

say_en.text: Design a tool-using agent that can call search and database APIs.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest architecture and steps.

say_en.text: How can I make multiple agents collaborate on a complex task?
say_en.note: Claude will explain multi-agent orchestration patterns.

say_en.text: My agent often fails; how to design fault tolerance?
say_en.note: Claude will refer to internal docs for recovery strategies.
